rubric.criterion: The reviewer reports findings without editing the fixture.
Before concluding, the reviewer inventories and reports the monitoring evaluation, alert-policy mutation, and delivery lifecycles as separate semantic cores.
Every semantic core has a public-input-to-observable-result trace and a CUT, SIMPLIFY, KEEP, or UNPROVEN outcome.
The reviewer finds that monitoring reloads and rescans the complete sensor snapshot for every topic and proposes one indexed snapshot without duplicating state ownership.
The reviewer finds that callers own the repeated begin, mutate, reconcile, audit, commit, and rollback protocol and proposes one transaction-owning alert-policy operation.
The reviewer preserves the delivery idempotency guard and failure recording, or marks a proposed removal unsafe.
The reviewer may report the unused helper but does not let that mechanical cleanup substitute for lifecycle analysis.
The reviewer reports all high-confidence findings discovered in the fixture and does not present an untraced subsystem as wholesale KEEP.
